title: elaphoglossum chrysolepis
intro: Elaphoglossum chrysolepis, commonly known as the golden lip fern, is a species of epiphytic fern in the family Dryopteridaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Elaphoglossum chrysolepis include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant activities, which may help to reduce inflammation, improve immune function, and protect against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as antimicrobial, anti-diabetic, and anti-cancer properties.
